scripts.setup:engine: rustup toolchain install 1.98.0 --profile minimal --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && cargo +1.98.0 install wasm-bindgen-cli --version 0.2.129 --locked
scripts.test:engine: npm run build && npm run test:rust && playwright test tests/workspace/engine.test.ts
scripts.test:bootstrap: npm run build && playwright test tests/workspace/bootstrap.test.ts
scripts.test:workspace: npm run build && playwright test tests/workspace
scripts.test:generators: npm run build && playwright test tests/generators

spielwerk.setup: npm ci && npx playwright install chromium && npm run setup:engine
spielwerk.engineProof: After build, open /src/engine/probe.html on the static host or Vite server. This internal Svelte fixture exercises actual Wasm, not a named tool. See src/engine/README.md for the sibling adapter contract.
spielwerk.development: npm run dev; open the printed local URL.
spielwerk.staticHosting: npm run build; serve or publish dist/ using any static HTTP host, including a subdirectory. npm run preview serves dist/ locally. No backend or file:// support is required.

testContracts.test:engine: Build the app and Wasm, run focused native Rust tests and Chromium boundary tests on development/static root/static subdirectory hosts.
testContracts.test:rust: Run the engine's native workspace-filtered tests using the pinned Rust toolchain and Cargo.lock.
testContracts.test:bootstrap: Build and run Chromium mount/asset smoke tests against Vite development and plain static HTTP hosting (Python 3 required).
testContracts.test:workspace: Build and run tests/workspace; later foundation tasks add focused tests here.
testContracts.test:generators: Build actual Wasm and run focused Chromium generator user-surface cases; empty collection fails.
testContracts.test:integration: Reserved for tests/integration, supplied by final integration. Fails with no tests until that task lands; not a bootstrap acceptance gate.
